root_cause: The production visibility workflow overrode the checker’s bounded route default with 8 route workers and 3 concurrent viewports, allowing up to 24 simultaneous browser navigations against the public production origin. Under that synthetic burst, two healthy English blog routes returned transient HTTP 403 and one healthy English AI Model Guide route produced no response, while all three were independently reachable immediately afterwards.
prevention_rule: Keep full public-route and three-viewport coverage, but cap canonical-production execution at four route workers and two concurrent viewports regardless of environment overrides. Treat the visibility checker and its workflow as verifier-only production control plane so assurance maintenance never requires a website redeploy.

evidence.independent_readback: all three routes returned full public content immediately after the failed parallel sweep
